resources.string: Compared: tables, columns (type, NULL, default, extra, order), indexes, foreign keys with their ON DELETE / ON UPDATE rules, CHECK constraints, view definitions and triggers. Routines, events and column collations are not compared. Differences are only listed; nothing is changed on either server.
Triggers were never read on side A, so they are not compared. Use “Read everything from the server” on that side.
Triggers were never read on side B, so they are not compared. Use “Read everything from the server” on that side.
Triggers were never read on either side, so they are not compared. Use “Read everything from the server” on a connected side.
